LanguageData.RG_DinosaursHideHeavy.label: heavy dinosaurs hide
LanguageData.RG_DinosaursHideHeavy.description: Heavy hide from larger, tougher theropod or sauropod. It's reasonbly good at protection.
LanguageData.RG_DinosaursHideMedium.label: medium dinosaurs hide
LanguageData.RG_DinosaursHideMedium.description: Medium theropod or sauropod hide, often from ones with few natural defenses.
LanguageData.RG_DinosaursHideThin.label: thin dinosaurs hide
LanguageData.RG_DinosaursHideThin.description: Lightweight, thin leather from a small theropod or sauropod. Doesn't insulate well.
LanguageData.RG_WoolRhinoceros.label: woolly rhinoceros wool
LanguageData.RG_WoolRhinoceros.description: Thick and coarse wool of a woolly rhinoceros. Quite warm.
LanguageData.RG_WoolStegosaurus.label: woolly stegosaurus wool
LanguageData.RG_WoolStegosaurus.description: Thick and coarse wool of a woolly stegosaurus. Quite warm.
